rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A comprehensive code intelligence MCP server that analyzes repositories of any size, from small projects to enterprise monorepos with millions of lines of code. Features 70+ specialized components providing end-to-end analysis capabilities. Tools include: analyze-codebase for comprehensive analysis with AST parsing, dependency graphs, and metrics; search-code for ML-powered semantic search across codebases; get-complexity for cyclomatic, cognitive, and Halstead complexity metrics; get-security-issues for vulnerability detection, secrets scanning, and compliance checks. Also includes discovery tools for scanning GitHub repositories and analyzing MCP tool definitions. Built with Python 3.9+ and supports monorepo analysis with intelligent chunking.
